integrity: The exact formula follows from the unique normalization a=g*u and a+c=g*v with gcd(u,v)=1, which turns the Niven condition into v|(b-1) and makes the digit bounds an exact range for g. The extremal prime characterization is proved separately, with explicit extra witnesses for every composite b-1. Computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts exactly the two-digit stratum of base-b Niven numbers. It does not provide a closed formula for longer digit lengths. The originality search inspected the complete generalized-Niven paper and the standard decimal database, but a short equivalent observation could exist in unindexed recreational literature. The exact public date is the verified online publication date of the archival primary source.
title: Two-digit Niven counts and a prime base-minus-one minimum
